The coin is up 122% over 30 minutes, has pulled back only 6.1% from its high, and sits on a 137 SOL pool that is deep enough to limit slippage on a $20 ticket. It is classified ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump seen and no graduation delay.

The case weakens fast on the early data. The curve shows bundle_share of 1.0 and only 3 buyers, and the first two minutes after graduation had a launch bot present with a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.54 and a top-5 buyer share of 55%. Those are signs of concentrated early supply, which the 15-minute flow does not clearly rule out. Demand here is real in the sense of volume, but whether it persists through the next 30-60 minutes is unproven, and the base rate for buying an alive coin in this age window is a roughly 20% loss per trade. My honest recommendation is that the scout case is weak and a skip is defensible.
